summary: Part 1 of 3 (00:00-05:21) of the Revibe "3.1 Buybox (Sellers)" training. Pierre walks through the Buybox Google Sheet: what the Buybox is, how the catalogue is split by market (AE columns for UAE and South Africa, SA columns for Saudi Arabia), who pays shipping in each market, what neutral buy box prices and buy box prices are, how the seller score moves prices, and what the lowest condition rule means. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened. The lock, minimum price, small/big price drop and "how to win" topics are only announced in the agenda and are not covered in this part.

terms.meaning: The tool sellers use to set prices for direct shipping orders to customers in Saudi Arabia, UAE and South Africa.
The shipping model the Buybox prices are set for, shown on the ecosystem diagram as 'Set prices for direct shipping'. The trainer does not define it further.
The shipping model the Fulfillment App prices are set for, shown on the ecosystem diagram as 'Set prices and quantities for fulfillment shipping'.
The list of devices offered to all Revibe sellers, shown on the Buybox tab.
The price a seller could have if their score were zero.
The neutral buy box price impacted by the seller's score. Sellers compete on buy box prices.
The seller's score, shown as a percentage in the Score column (for example -4.00%). A better score gives better prices; the score does not affect lowest condition devices.
Devices with the lowest storage, the most basic colour and the lowest quality condition. Sellers compete only on price for these devices and the score has no impact.
Columns labelled AE (Buybox AE, Wins AE, Price AE, Neutral Buybox AE). The trainer says the red columns are for UAE and South Africa. The summary table labels the group 'UAE / ZA'.
Columns labelled SA (Buybox SA, Wins SA, Price SA, Neutral Buybox SA). The trainer says the green columns are for Saudi Arabia. The summary table labels the group 'KSA'.
Columns that show TRUE or FALSE for UAE and Saudi Arabia. The trainer does not define what TRUE means in part 1.
The trainer says sellers can lock prices in UAE and South Africa by sending devices to the Revibe warehouse. Only announced in part 1.
Listed as a topic in the agenda (Min AE / Min SA columns exist). Not covered in part 1.
The delivery partner for UAE orders, according to the trainer. Name from speech only.
The delivery partner for South Africa orders, according to the trainer. Name from speech only.
Column with sales bands such as 0-1, 1-3, 3-5, 20-50. The trainer does not explain the bands in part 1.
